column15: We are doing the taxonomy of Populus. We use whole genome resequencing data to check if the species is accepted or the parents of hybrid Populus species.  So far, we have completed the whole genome resequencing work of all Populus species in China. But our results found that many species were hybrids, and their parents were likely from foreign taxa. So I would also like to obtain silica gel dried leaf materials of some species from North America to extract DNA and for whole genome resequencing.
